categories.main_business_segments: Healthpeak Properties, Inc. operates three primary business segments: Life Science, Medical Office, and Continuing Care Retirement Community (CCRC). The Life Science segment includes laboratory and office space leased to biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device companies. The Medical Office segment consists of medical office buildings and hospitals, while the CCRC segment comprises retirement communities offering a continuum of care. The company also has a small non-reportable segment, primarily consisting of debt investments and joint ventures.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Healthpeak's core business is the acquisition, development, ownership, leasing, and management of healthcare real estate. The company focuses on high-quality, purpose-built properties with advanced infrastructure for life science tenants (e.g., specialized HVAC, lab equipment), and medical office buildings designed for healthcare providers. Property management, tenant improvements, and redevelopment are key operational methods, with a focus on sustainability and resilience in building design and operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are tenants in the healthcare sector, including biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies, hospitals, physician practices, and operators of retirement communities. Major end markets include the life sciences industry, outpatient medical services, and senior living/retirement care. Key tenants include Amgen, Inc. (life science) and HCA Healthcare, Inc. (medical office).
categories.geographic_coverage: Healthpeak operates exclusively in the United States, with a portfolio concentrated in major life science and healthcare markets. Significant geographic exposure includes California (notably San Francisco and San Diego), Massachusetts (Boston/Cambridge), Texas, and Florida. As of 2021, 34% of assets were in California, 16% in Massachusetts, 11% in Florida, and 10% in Texas.
categories.supply_chain_position: Healthpeak operates as a downstream participant in the healthcare real estate supply chain, serving as a landlord and property manager for healthcare providers, life science companies, and senior living operators. The company does not provide healthcare services directly but enables such services through its real estate assets.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is on long-term value creation through investment in high-quality, private-pay healthcare real estate in three core asset classes: life science, medical office, and CCRC. Healthpeak emphasizes portfolio quality, geographic and tenant diversification, disciplined balance sheet management, and strong partnerships with leading healthcare operators. R&D is reflected in property development, redevelopment, and sustainability initiatives, including ESG programs and climate resilience.
categories.revenue_model: Healthpeak generates revenue primarily through rental income from leasing its properties under triple-net, net, and gross leases. In the CCRC segment, revenue also includes resident fees and services, often paid directly by residents. The company may also earn income from property management, development fees, and interest from debt investments or joint ventures.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Healthpeak is a leading S&P 500 healthcare REIT, competing with other healthcare-focused REITs, private equity investors, pension funds, and institutional real estate investors. Major competitors include Welltower, Ventas, and other large healthcare REITs. Healthpeak is positioned as a top-tier owner of life science and medical office assets, with a reputation for high-quality properties and strong operator relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2021, Healthpeak had total assets of $15.3 billion and a market capitalization of $12.8 billion. The company reported total revenues of $1.9 billion and Adjusted NOI of $1.03 billion for 2021. Healthpeak completed a major strategic shift in 2021 by exiting senior housing triple-net and SHOP portfolios, focusing on growth in life science and medical office segments. The company maintains an investment-grade balance sheet and has demonstrated steady growth in its core segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Healthpeak's value proposition centers on its high-quality, well-located healthcare real estate portfolio, strong tenant/operator relationships, and expertise in property management and development. The company differentiates itself through its focus on private-pay asset classes, geographic concentration in top U.S. life science and healthcare markets, and commitment to ESG and sustainability. Its ability to provide flexible, scalable space solutions and long-term partnerships with leading healthcare organizations enhances tenant retention and portfolio stability.
